items.headline: Louie Bradbury joins Stoke City after leaving Manchester United academy
items.summary: Youth academy striker Louie Bradbury has departed Manchester United and signed with Stoke City.

items.headline: Manchester United submit Champions League squad for 2026-27 season
items.summary: United confirmed their 25-man Champions League squad selection including an 18-year-old prospect.

items.headline: Michael Carrick assesses Manchester United's transfer window
items.summary: Manager Michael Carrick provided assessment of the club's transfer activity during the 2026 summer window.

items.headline: Patrick Dorgu positioned to solve Manchester United left-back shortage
items.summary: Manager Michael Carrick suggests Patrick Dorgu can fill left-back role after deadline day transfer window closed.
